تحتقرون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِرُونَ (taḥtaqirūna) /taħ.ta.qi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# تُحْتَقَرُونَ (tuḥtaqarūna) /tuħ.ta.qa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
